rules.content:
title: BPH IP Block Migration Post-Sanctions
status: experimental
description: Detect IP address blocks previously associated with sanctioned or seized BPH providers appearing under new BGP announcements from different ASNs. Track continuity of malicious hosting through IP block
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: bgp_monitoring
    service: ip_allocation
detection:
    selection:
        previously_sanctioned_ip_range: true
        new_bgp_announcement: true
        different_asn: true
        timeframe|lte: "90d"
    condition: selection
level: high
rules.title: DL-0110: BPH IP Block Migration Post-Sanctions (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Cloud Provider IP Abuse for BPH Resale
status: experimental
description: Detect patterns consistent with legitimate cloud provider IP blocks being resold for BPH: unusual CNAME density (100+ domains per IP), diverse domain registrants sharing the same cloud IP range, and h
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: cname_analysis
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        cloud_provider_ip: true
        cname_density|gt: 100
        diverse_registrants: true
        abuse_ratio|gt: "threshold"
    condition: selection
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0111: Cloud Provider IP Abuse for BPH Resale (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: CNAME Clustering for DGA Domain Networks
status: experimental
description: Detect anomalous CNAME record density where hundreds or thousands of apparently unrelated domains share CNAME chains terminating at a small number of infrastructure endpoints. Indicates centrally mana
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: cname_analysis
    service: passive_dns
detection:
    selection:
        cname_chain_endpoint_count|gt: "threshold"
        unique_domain_count|gt: 500
        cname_chain_depth|gte: 2
    condition: selection
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0112: CNAME Clustering for DGA Domain Networks (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for BPH ASN Connection Correlation")`
`comment("Detects traffic to known BPH ASNs, NiceNIC domains, or Dynamic DNS abuse")`
index=flame_network sourcetype=flame:dns_monitoring
| lookup bph_asn_watchlist destination_asn OUTPUT bph_provider_name, bph_risk_level
| eval bph_asn_match = if(isnotnull(bph_provider_name), 1, 0)
| eval nicenic_match = if(like(domain_registrar, "%nicenic%"), 1, 0)
| eval dyndns_match = if(
    match(query, "\.(afraid\.org|mooo\.com|hopto\.org|zapto\.org|sytes\.net)$"), 1, 0)
| where bph_asn_match=1 OR nicenic_match=1 OR dyndns_match=1
| eval match_type = case(
    bph_asn_match=1, "bph_asn",
    nicenic_match=1, "nicenic_registrar",
    dyndns_match=1, "dynamic_dns")
| eval risk_category = case(
    bph_asn_match=1 AND nicenic_match=1, "high",
    bph_asn_match=1, "medium",
    nicenic_match=1, "medium",
    dyndns_match=1, "low")
| stats count AS connection_count dc(src_ip) AS unique_sources
        values(query) AS domains values(destination_asn) AS asns
        values(bph_provider_name) AS bph_providers
        values(match_type) AS match_types
  by src_ip
| sort - connection_count
rules.title: DL-0178: Bulletproof Hosting ASN Connection Correlation — Traffic to Known BPH Networks (SPLUNK)
